correctness.rationale: Conditioning on the coordinate and delay gives the scalar second-moment recurrence exactly. Perron--Frobenius gives the unique factor; convexity of \(q^{-D}\) gives stochastic/convex-order comparisons; the deterministic-delay and near-singular formulas follow by direct expansion. The actual verifier was inspected but is only corroboration.

originality.rationale: The closest current paper gives general max-delay/communication-pattern energy bounds, not an exact full-delay-law second-moment closure. Older stochastic-delay sources establish convergence conditions or broader rate models; the searched material does not give the audited scalar law or its distribution-order consequences.

value.rationale: This is a natural exactly solvable asynchronous-solver benchmark that resolves effects of the full delay distribution, including variability at fixed mean, which max-delay bounds cannot express.
